reason: Checked against the code and data; it holds as a cheap, no-slot check of a path that would otherwise run for the first time on the hidden set, with four gaps. (1) The claim is verified. ga_train.json has 0113de3b|c8e2a523 (offset [45,50,11,148], 55 frames, spatial 0.088) and 0b24845f|2f31fc2f ([-49,12,88,209], 51 frames, spatial 0.098). The other pairs that touch these stems (2f31fc2f|db3c847b, 3a861e03|c8e2a523) fall outside the 4-stem set, so the kernel sees exactly 2 pairs. The no-pair G-D dummy runs the writer hold, but NOT splice_all, overlapcons_check, the writing of spliced graphs, the notebook's post-writer hard checks (the dt==+1 asserts) or GPU registration with accepted pairs. (2) The build fits. The wt5 builder (ff438f7) does not refuse overlapcons+trainlab. The trainlab hooks sit in the per-dataset post-processing, while the overlapcons hook sits in write_test_submission, so they do not collide. The trainlab 'final' npz is the pre-splice graph, so replaying it gives a clean parity target. (3) Value is only for private, and conditional. The test adds no score. It protects the one branch where K6 would be adopted on a public tie (public embryo without overlaps). There, wrong but well-formed spliced rows on the private embryos would never be seen by G-LB. Caveats: G-A FAILED as pre-registered (43/62 < 60, PC8-01), so the default is STOP, and the test only matters if the user continues AND G-P shows overlap AND G-B passes. (4) Gaps. (a) trainlab forces the insertion to dump-only (DIVINS_THRESH>1, builder l.2317). The lab therefore exercises the control_splice arm, not PRIMARY ins35_splice, and the insertion+splice interplay stays untested (it only reaches the same skipped_fork branch). (b) overlap_lab.py checks kernel CSV parity only against control (l.795). It needs a kernel-CSV vs control_splice comparison, and registration must be restricted to the lab's own 4 stems, not the 71-clip joint run. (c) With overlaps this small, spliced may be 0 without any bug, so 'spliced > 0' can fail falsely. (d) Timing from 400 frames does not bound the hidden 10-20k frames (PC8-03) unless it is projected.
